failurePaths.errorMidStep: Synthetic mid-game apply exception retains rotated init, failed action and actual first-turn materialization coverage.
failurePaths.reloadAndRepro: Same seed/targets/ordinal reproduces complete FuzzGame and inline plus interactive replay hashes. A retained CLI diagnostic probe preserves mixed targets, ordinal and interactive replay frequency. MAX_SAFE_INTEGER rotation remains exact.
failurePaths.partialWrites: New targeting has no persistent writes. Passing games write no logs. Existing synchronous failure writer partial-write/collision limitations are recorded in pre-existing evidence.
failurePaths.invalidAndStale: Synthetic contracts reject unknown/malformed/empty/ambiguous/oversized card lists, non-recurring Dreamwell, pending/vanilla/authored-empty Dreamsigns, removed figment definitions, support UUID collisions and invalid ordinals. Five CLI probes each exit 1 before writing game logs.
failurePaths.concurrentExecution: Pool definitions are read-only and each game allocates fresh setup/coverage. Repeated games in one engine reproduce exact outcomes and counts. Separate processes have independent target state; callers use distinct seed prefixes for the existing failure-file namespace.
